mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wx_moment_send_log ( id, corp_id, task_id, invoke_id, user_id, publish_status, tenant_id, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.id}, #{item.corpId}, #{item.taskId}, #{item.invokeId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.publishStatus}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE publish_status = VALUES(publish_status), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT invoke_id AS invokeId, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpublishedCnt FROM wx_moment_send_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY invoke_id ORDER BY invoke_id DESC

SELECT invoke_id AS invokeId, user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS totalCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedCnt, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpublishedCnt FROM wx_moment_send_log WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY invoke_id, user_id
